name: security-kit
description: Tailored, standards-based security for any application — web, Android, iOS — and the AI that writes it.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @seckit/core && npm run build -w @seckit/cli && npm run build -w @seckit/node && npm run build -w @seckit/web && npm run build -w @seckit/mcp && npm run build -w @seckit/ui
scripts.build:site: npm run build -w @seckit/core && node packages/ui/scripts/build-app.mjs && npm run build -w @seckit/site
